title: Linen Layout
description: Count towel designs composable from available stripe patterns.
writeup:
## Approach

Given a set of short towel patterns and a list of target designs, determine which designs can be built by concatenating patterns (with reuse).

## Key Insight

This is a classic dynamic programming problem, similar to the word-break problem. For each position `i` in the design, `dp[i]` counts the number of ways to build the prefix `design[:i]` using available patterns.

## Part 1

Count how many designs have at least one valid composition (`dp[n] > 0`).

## Part 2

Sum `dp[n]` across all designs to get the total number of arrangements. The DP naturally counts all valid compositions.
